Messages.Author: Teeka
Messages.Body:
The pic is on Ken Meyer's site. It's called "corpse child" and he says
it was done for KMW. So it could be this card had been around a long
time already because it was dropped from KMW to be in LoB, and someone
got their hands on it and now claims it's a promo.

I guess this card will very likely be in LoB, but it always seemed
strange to me if cards would allegedly be sold/given away as a promo
before WW would make any announcement about them. If it is a promo
though, the distributors of the magazines will probably have a bunch of
copies already to put in the plastic wrapper before sending the mags
out.

So: my guess is it's either fake, or some magazine distributor took it
from the mags before the release date, or it was stolen from WW. I for
one don't want it.
